text:
Filter coffee in Bengaluru just went from ₹20 to ₹25, and we still pay ₹150 for a latte we nurse for four hours.

My weekday morning is one SILT stick in water. 80 mg caffeine with 200 mg L-theanine, 5 g fibre, D3, K2, B12. About ₹60 a day. Filter coffee is for Sundays.
trend: Bengaluru filter coffee goes from Rs 20 to Rs 25; the Rs 150 work-from-cafe latte debate
why: Bengaluru coffee prices are local news this month and our audience lives in that city.
